title: H1 Proportional Metric Scaling Test (SL=30, TP1=30, TP2=60, Trail=15, Buffer=8)
research_question: Does scaling trade metrics proportionally to fit the 1-Hour timeframe (SL=30 pips, TP1=30 pips, TP2=60 pips, Trail=15 pips, FibBuffer=8 pips) eliminate the premature stop-out failure observed in EXP-0020/EXP-0021 and produce profitable results with max drawdown <= 8.0% on GBPUSD across both training and 2025 validation partitions?
hypothesis: Proportionally scaling the stop loss to 30 pips and TP targets to 30/60 pips aligns trade geometry with the 25-45 pip Average True Range of H1 candles, allowing pullback wicks to breathe while dynamic lot sizing preserves 1.0% account risk per trade.

facts: EXP-0020 on H1 with tight 15-pip SL failed (-$869.85 profit, 13.78% DD) because 15 pips is smaller than the typical H1 candle noise.
EXP-0022/EXP-0023 on M30 achieved Profit Factor 3.68 (training) and 1.49 (2025 validation) with a 2.07%-3.88% drawdown.
H1 candles average 25-45 pips of range on GBPUSD, requiring at least a 30-pip stop loss to avoid noise stop-outs.
inferences: Scaling SL to 30 pips, TP1 to 30 pips, TP2 to 60 pips, and Trail to 15 pips will resolve the ATR/SL mismatch on H1.
Dynamic lot sizing (InpRiskPct = 1.0%) will automatically halve position size for the 30-pip SL, keeping total account risk constant.
evidence: EXP-0020 total_trades=104, profit_factor=0.75, loss_trades=48, total_net_profit=-869.85, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=13.78
EXP-0023 total_trades=59, profit_factor=1.49, win_rate=74.58%, total_net_profit=505.25, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=3.88

independent_variables.name: timeframe
independent_variables.rationale: Transition execution chart timeframe from M30 to H1.

independent_variables.name: InpMaxSLPips
independent_variables.rationale: Widen hard stop loss to accommodate H1 candle ATR range and prevent premature wick stop-outs.

independent_variables.name: InpTP1Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Widen first take-profit target to capture full H1 impulse swing before partial close.

independent_variables.name: InpTP2Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Widen secondary take-profit target for multi-hour runners.

independent_variables.name: InpTrailPips
independent_variables.rationale: Widen trailing step to prevent premature runner exit during normal H1 pullbacks.

independent_variables.name: InpFibBuffer
independent_variables.rationale: Widen Fibonacci zone buffer to match H1 candle resolution.

assumptions: Dynamic lot sizing maintains risk at exactly 1.0% per trade despite wider 30-pip stop loss.
H1 bars provide valid rejection signals within the 8-pip buffer zone.
expected_observations: Total net profit remains positive on GBPUSD H1.
Loss trades decrease substantially compared to EXP-0020 (48 losses).
falsification_conditions: Total net profit <= 0.0 on training or validation partition.
